title: 9.3 Similar Right Triangles

icans: I can show that the altitude to the hypotenuse makes three similar right triangles.
I can find the geometric mean of two numbers.
I can use the Geometric Mean Theorems to find missing lengths.

vocab: the segment from the right angle ________________ to the hypotenuse
of two ___________ numbers a and b: the positive number x with x² = ab, so x = √(ab)
triangles whose ________________ angles are congruent and whose corresponding sides are proportional

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: three triangles from one

blocks.p: Cut your card on a diagonal. Draw the altitude from the right angle to the hypotenuse and cut along it. Measure the angles of all three triangles.
The three triangles are similar because ______________________________.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Right Triangle Similarity Theorem: the altitude to the hypotenuse of a right triangle forms two triangles that are _______________ to the original triangle and to each other.

blocks.stem: In right △ABC, C̅D̅ is the altitude to the hypotenuse. Name the three similar triangles.

notes: Geometric mean of a and b: x = _______________

blocks.stem:
Find the geometric mean of each pair of numbers.
a.  4 and 25
b.  6 and 15

notes: Geometric Mean (Altitude) Theorem: the altitude to the hypotenuse is the geometric mean of the two _______________ of the hypotenuse: altitude² = (one segment)(other segment).

blocks.stem: The altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of 4 and 9. Find the length of the altitude, x.

notes: Geometric Mean (Leg) Theorem: each leg is the geometric mean of the _______________ and the segment of the hypotenuse _______________ that leg: leg² = (hypotenuse)(segment next to the leg).
